content_html:
1st September 2026

  • "rows"
    from 
    execute_sql
    is now an array of objects. Previously it was an array of arrays. This should help weaker models avoid losing track of which positional array element maps to which column. #1
  • Now depends on
    • mcp>=2.1.1
    .

This is the first non-alpha release of the plugin. I'm confident it's ready as I've been using it quite a bit myself.
